title: RealAPI
description: This mod has alot of code I think would be nice to develop with!
body:
This mod adds things for development such as:
- Common attributes
- Many Events
- Stack Holder / Bundle Like system for creating bundle like items

Feel free to use this library if you want to!


<details>
<summary>Common Attributes</summary>

**Movement Scale:** Effects how fast you go in most ways\
**Shield Fragility:** Effects how long your shield is disabled for\
**Armor Penetration:** Reduces effective armor of enemies\
**Appetite:** Increases exhaustion\
**Charge Time:** Effects how long it takes to charge a crossbow\
**Ranged Attack Multiplier:** Multiplier on projectile damage\
**Bane of Adolescence:** Increases damage dealt to babies\
**Fire Damage Multiplier:** Multiplier on non-lava fire damage\
**Dodge Chance:** Chance to just dodge an attack\
**Intellijence:** Effects xp gain from orbs

</details>


<details>
<summary>Events</summary>

**Container Screen Events:**
- Init
- MouseActions

**Entity Attribute Events:**
- Updated

**Set Angles Events:**
- Humanoid Models

</details>
